articles.title: AI agents make 138 million crypto payments as U.S. dominates spending on AI models
articles.snippet: U.S.-linked wallets account for just over 88% of tracked AI model payments, dwarfing China’s 0.1% share, according to new Chainalysis research.

articles.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Bugging Office, Company Says AI Caught Him
articles.snippet: A Saudi national working at OpenAI allegedly hid an encrypted audio recorder behind a TV in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its own models helped trace it back to him.
